Categories auto-sort by ID: you can see how to deal with it at the WP Wiki. http://wiki.wordpress.org/wp_list_cats

I also have all the info on how to do the post-by-post navigation (much of which I got from Shelley Powers at Burningbird), and probably some other fixes floating around as well. Scriptygoddess has stuff, too. And if you can figure out how to get post-by-email working . . .
